messages:
alex: Heads-up — we're seeing a sustained uptick in 95th token latency for route=search-autocomplete since ~09:12 UTC. P95 jumped from 220ms to ~700ms. Noticed eviction spikes in KV cache around the same time.
jamie: @alex can you paste the metrics names? I want to add a quick panel.
alex: Metrics we have so far: kvcache_hit_total{route}, kvcache_miss_total{route}, kvcache_evictions_total{route}, kvcache_memory_bytes{gpu,route}. Also token_latency_ms{route,quant, kernel,hit_or_miss}
jamie: nice. I'll prototype a per-route dashboard: row1 QPS + P50/P95/P99 token_latency, row2 kvcache hitrate, evictions/s, row3 memory per-gpu heatmap + top routes by reuse. Simple sparkline for evictions.
sarah: +1. For hitrate calc use rate(kvcache_hit_total[5m]) / rate(kvcache_hit_total[5m] + kvcache_miss_total[5m]) — we should tag by model_version too.
liam: Can we get token-level latency split by cache hit/miss? That's the only way to confirm KV is the culprit.
alex: We already emit token_latency_ms bucketed by hit_or_miss. Example histogram name: token_latency_ms_bucket{route,le,hit_or_miss="hit"}
liam: Perfect. Add a panel that overlays P95(hit) vs P95(miss) — if miss dominates latency we can prioritize prefix reuse.
perf-bot: Deploy notice: rollout v2-kernel-selector completed at 1802500970; config changed batch_threshold from 8 -> 12 for some routes.
jamie: That aligns with the timing. We should correlate kernel_selector changes with evictions. Maybe the new kernels increase per-token memory or affect KV lifespan.
sarah: Also see these logs from the runtime profiler (sampled):
```
[09:11:58] route=search-autocomplete kernel=matmul_opt v=2 batch=12 kv_evicted=128 mem_bytes_before=1.2e9 mem_bytes_after=1.1e9
[09:12:11] route=search-autocomplete trace_id=tx_83fe latency_token_1=45ms latency_token_50=620ms hit=false
```
liam: Good traces. Suggestions: 1) Add a per-route label on kvcache_entries_by_prefix; 2) Expose kvcache_reuse_ratio{route} (reuse hits / total entries accessed) 3) Eviction age distribution histogram.
alex: For dashboards let's wire: - metric: kvcache_reuse_ratio{route} - panel: stacked bar top 10 routes by reuse - correlation: event overlay (deploys, kernel switches)
jamie: On the instrumentation side I will: emit kvcache_reuse_ratio, add kvcache_eviction_age_seconds histogram, and tag kvcache_memory_bytes with kernel_type and quant_profile. I'll open a PR shortly.
sarah: For alerting: add an SLO burn alert if p95_token_latency(route) > 500ms for 5m AND kvcache_evictions_total(rate) > 50/s.
liam: +1. Also create a Grafana drilldown: click a route -> show top 50 traces, sampled token latencies, and last 10 eviction events.
alex: Thanks — assigning follow-ups: jamie will build panels, sarah will add alerts, liam will add trace drilldown, and I'll investigate kernel vs kv memory interplay. Can we meet quick in 15 to triage?
jamie: can do. meeting in #eng-runtime if needed. :thumbsup:
perf-bot: profile artifacts uploaded: s3://redwood-inference/profiles/180250/kv-regress-search-autocomplete.tar.gz
sarah: PR opened: github.com/redwood-inference/observability/pull/472 — includes metrics + dashboard JSON.
liam: I'll validate with a canary run on dedicated to reproduce.
alex: Awesome. If anyone hits blockers ping me directly.
